mechanism.plausibility_rationale: While the mechanism involves inhibiting hepatic gluconeogenesis, AMPK activators like metformin do not typically cause hypoglycemia when used as monotherapy because they do not stimulate insulin secretion and the body retains compensatory mechanisms to maintain glucose levels. Hypoglycemia is generally only a risk when these agents are combined with insulin or insulin secretagogues.
